messages:
Nora: Proposal: run a "surgical" resident-write validation for a handful of EU tenants tonight. Low blast, no state change. Thoughts? :scalpel:

Carlos: +1. Prefer shadow+split rather than direct handoff. Shadow writes that never commit are safer.

Priya: Agree. Requirements: 1) shadow must respect X-Consent-Token 2) all shadow payloads hashed for PII 3) kv cache disabled for shadow path.

Ivy: Telemetry: shadow_mismatch_rate, shadow_latency_p95_delta, shadow_cpu. Auto-revert if mismatch_rate > 0.05% for 10m.

Nora: Rollout plan: staging canary -> 5k synthetic shadow writes -> 0.5% prod for 4h -> 5% if green. Primary rollback owner: Carlos, secondary: Ivy.

Priya: Add header X-Policy: surgical-shadow-v1 and X-Shadow: true. comparator will run async with threshold 0.02.

ops-bot: Canary queued: proxy/surgical-shadow-v1 -> canary-11. Dashboard: https://obs.local/canary/11 :rocket:

Carlos: I'll open the PR with proxy rule and dashboard. If anyone sees unexpected tenant-level consent drops, @Carlos immediately.

Nora: thanks all — will post results and suggested follow-up primitive (traffic-scalpel) after canary. :hourglass:
